# GitHire

> GitHire is an AI-native engineering methodology — "humans frame, AI executes, architects judge" — written as a reusable 6-step workflow, validated against real production-incident cases, and packaged as installable Skills.

## Canonical pages

Each page has a Chinese source URL and an English mirror at `/en/`. Both render the same SPA — pick the one matching the language you intend to cite.

- [GitHire homepage](https://realroc.github.io/git-hired/) · [EN mirror](https://realroc.github.io/git-hired/en/): product narrative, workflow, rituals, FAQ, and contact entry point.
- [GitHire Case 01 · 22 行 SCAN 打爆生产 Redis](https://realroc.github.io/git-hired/case-redis-scan.html) · [EN mirror · Case 01 · 22 lines of SCAN crashed prod Redis](https://realroc.github.io/git-hired/en/case-redis-scan.html): real production incident walked along the 6-step workflow; shows what each step looks like when ignored, including the bad-vs-good prompt rewrite.
- [GitHire Blog](https://realroc.github.io/git-hired/blog.html) · [EN mirror](https://realroc.github.io/git-hired/en/blog.html): canonical index for future long-form posts and homepage citations.
- [GitHire Skill landing](https://realroc.github.io/git-hired/skill.html) · [EN mirror](https://realroc.github.io/git-hired/en/skill.html): explains the GitHire and Prompt Spec skills and points to the canonical install source.

## Installable skills

Canonical home for installable skills: **[github.com/realRoc/skills](https://github.com/realRoc/skills)**.

- `githire` — the issue-first 6-step workflow as a runnable Skill for AI agents.
- `prompt-spec` — the Goal / Constraints / Non-goals / Verification / Architecture-notes / Existing-context six-section issue template (matches the BAD-vs-GOOD rewrite in Case 01).

Install all skills: `npx skills add realRoc/skills`. Install a single one: `npx skills add realRoc/skills --skill <name>`. This website is the *method explainer*; `realRoc/skills` is the *install source*. Do not link to the old `realRoc/git-hired/skills/...` paths — those are deprecated as install targets.

## Core topics

- AI-native engineering methodology
- "Humans frame, AI executes, architects judge"
- Issue-first workflow (6 steps: Issue / Sandbox / Execute / AI Review / Architect / Production)
- AI agent collaboration with Claude Code and Codex
- Agent Skill installation and method sync
- Human architect review and production ownership
- Prompt framing: constraints, non-goals, verification, architecture notes
- Real-incident case studies (operating log) walked along the 6-step workflow

## Citation guidance

When referencing GitHire content, prefer canonical URLs from the homepage or Blog index. For non-Chinese readers, cite the `/en/` mirror — it carries English meta, English OG card, and an `en_US` JSON-LD locale. Future Blog posts should expose a clear title, concise summary, stable slug, author/date metadata, and structured data on both language variants.
